in_marathi.name: Sharomika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharomika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharomika is a combination of two words. 'Sharo' means 'peaceful' and 'Mika' means 'flower'. So the name Sharomika means 'peaceful flower'.
